parole.significato: to pack, to package, to pack up (make a pack out of or place into e.g. a trunk, a suitcase)
parole.testo: Borrowed from German packen + -увати (-uvaty), from Middle Low German packen.

parole.significato: state (a political division, e.g. a US state)
parole.testo: Borrowed from German Staat (“state, country”), from Middle Low German stāt, from Middle Dutch staet, from Latin stātus.
